map.每个符号含点/划及间隔，实际时长约为点划数 × 1.5 个单位: Each symbol has dots/dashes and gaps; actual duration ≈ dot-dash count × 1.5 units

map.PARIS 标准下 1 WPM ≈ 单位时长 1200 ms，20 WPM ≈: Under PARIS standard, 1 WPM ≈ 1200 ms per unit; 20 WPM ≈ 60 ms per unit.
map.约定点=1、划=3 单位，字符内间隔=1、字符间=3、单词间=7 单位。: Convention: dot=1, dash=3 units; intra-character gap=1, inter-character=3, inter-word=7 units.
map.标准摩斯仅覆盖拉丁字母数字与少数标点，中文需先转拼音/数字。: Standard Morse covers only Latin letters, digits and few punctuation; Chinese must be converted to pinyin/digits first.
